description: Real UK MOT failure data for a used car: per-category failure rates (overall and at a given mileage) and the riskiest components with typical failure mileages. Use whenever a user is buying, comparing or maintaining a used car sold in the UK. Data is aggregated from official DfT MOT test results — real outcomes, not estimates. Responses carry a whatbreaks.uk attribution line.
